name: Collector App
description:
Docent is a radical new platform for art collectors to engage with contemporary art. Their mission is to bring a passionate expertise and a breadth of knowledge from across the contemporary art ecosystem together with the visionary research of leading scientists and thinkers in the realm of machine learning.

As a consultant, I was leading the product and design team as well as overseeing the product development. In the past 2 years working on this project I built the design system and all the new product experience. I also had the chance to code a significant part of the new structure we built on Expo.
